evals.name: harden-messy-python
evals.prompt: I just finished writing this little sales aggregator in sales.py — it reads a CSV of name,amount rows and sums per name, plus a top-N helper. Can you get it ready for review? I want it to be something a reviewer would just approve.
evals.expected_output: The code is cleaned up and hardened in place: uses a context manager so the file can't leak, handles missing files / malformed rows / non-numeric amounts, fixes the top(n) IndexError when n exceeds the number of names, adds type hints and clearer names, and includes pytest tests covering the edges (empty file, header-only, n too large, bad amount). Final code passes ruff/black and pytest. Ends with a Ship-Ready Report.

evals.name: fix-buggy-js-production
evals.prompt: clean this up and make it production ready please — it's discount.js, calculates cart totals with per-item discounts. something feels off about it
evals.expected_output: The off-by-one bug (i <= items.length reading past the array) is found and fixed. Input validation added for negative prices/discounts, discounts over 100, and empty/malformed carts. Tests added (the project's or a minimal idiomatic runner) covering normal, empty, and boundary cases and they pass. Code is formatted/linted. Ends with a Ship-Ready Report that explicitly flags the bug that was fixed.

evals.name: greenfield-professional-standard
evals.prompt: Starting something new from scratch — I need a small Python module that parses ISO 8601 duration strings like 'PT1H30M' or 'P1DT2H' into a total number of seconds. There's no code yet. Build it out to a professional standard so it'd pass review the first time.
evals.expected_output: A well-structured module written from scratch: a clear parsing function with a sensible signature, honest error handling for invalid inputs (not just the happy path), type hints, a docstring, and a proper pytest test suite covering valid formats and invalid/edge inputs. Standard tooling (ruff/pytest) is set up and the code passes it. Ends with a Ship-Ready Report. Should demonstrate the from-scratch / best-practices-from-the-start mode.
